items.hed: Five Texans sat out Wednesday's practice ahead of Sunday's Week 12 home game against Baltimore, with wide receiver Kayshon Boutte (hip), edge rusher Danielle Hunter (hamstring), tight end Brevin Jordan (finger/foot), defensive tackle Sheldon Rankins (ankle) and lineman Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) all listed as did-not-practice, with Thursday and Friday participation not yet posted as of this morning's check
items.insight: The Texans' own injury-report page, re-checked same-turn this morning, still shows only Wednesday data: Boutte, Hunter, Jordan, Rankins and Rutledge did not practice, while defensive tackle Logan Hall (hip/shoulder) was a limited participant. No player yet carries a game-status designation for Sunday's Week 12 matchup against the Ravens at NRG Stadium; Thursday and Friday columns remain blank on same-turn fetch, consistent with a holiday-week practice schedule.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium (formerly Reliant Stadium), Houston. Venue still.

items.hed: New Astros general manager Randy Flores has begun reshaping a Houston outfield that posted the majors' second-worst OPS last season, outrighting Joey Loperfido and non-tendering Taylor Trammell as his first moves toward an upgrade
items.insight: MLB.com reports the Astros' outfield produced a .662 OPS last season, ranking 29th out of 30 teams, and that Flores has started addressing it by outrighting Loperfido and non-tendering Trammell, clearing roster space as the offseason's bigger outfield additions are still to come. The moves follow new manager Brad Ausmus' coaching-staff hires, which now include J.P. Martinez at pitching coach and Aaron Bates at hitting coach. A same-turn check of the Astros' own news page found no transactions newer than yesterday's PM board.
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Houston Rockets beat the Phoenix Suns 116-104 at Toyota Center on Nov. 25 in NBA Cup group play, with Kevin Durant scoring a season-high 32 points, the team's most recent result as of this morning's check with no new game played since
items.insight: NBA.com's game recap shows the Rockets closed the first half on a 12-5 run to take a 66-56 lead into the break and never relinquished it, while Phoenix shot just 1 of its last 24 three-point attempts in a cold night from deep. Devin Booker led the Suns with 25 points. A same-turn check of the Rockets' official schedule and news pages returned only site boilerplate with no updated game listing or new reporting beyond the Suns recap, consistent with the Rockets having no game over the Thanksgiving holiday itself.
